messages:
alyssa (Docs): Heads-up — opened PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/492 to standardize param casing in SDK snippets. TL;DR: switch from snake_case to lowerCamelCase for client options and param names across JS/TS examples. Want a quick sync before we merge.

samir (SDK): Prefer lowerCamel for JS/TS, but keep snake_case in REST/cURL examples. Need a clear migration note and a mapping table.

jess (Writer): Voice question — should the docs say 'prefer lowerCamelCase' or 'use lowerCamelCase'? Tone matters for expectations.

michael (Eng-ML): Backend accepts both forms right now, so "recommended" is accurate. We shouldn't say "required" unless we plan to drop support.

andrew (PM): Customers are tripping over param_name vs paramName in our quickstarts — propose a short mapping table (old -> new) and a short migration section in the SDK migration guide.

docs-bot: PR #492 CI passed :white_check_mark: (build: linux-tests, docs-lint)

sophia (DevEx): For Python, idiomatic snake_case is probably better — show Python examples using snake_case and JS/TS using lowerCamelCase. Also add a tiny snippet showing how to call the REST API with the JSON keys the backend accepts.

samir (SDK): Agreed. Plan: update JS/TS snippets to lowerCamel, leave Python as snake_case but add a note that both JSON key forms are accepted. I'll add unit tests for codegen.

jess (Writer): Wording proposal: "We recommend using the SDK idioms for each language (lowerCamelCase in JS/TS, snake_case in Python). The service accepts both forms for backward compatibility." Short, prescriptive, but not punitive.

alyssa (Docs): I'll update the PR with: 1) migration guide and mapping table, 2) per-language snippet changes, 3) explicit note on compatibility, 4) a short FAQ entry. Also will add a 'what changed' blurb for the release notes.

michael (Eng-ML): Optional: include a tiny diagram or table showing how query keys map at the wire level (SDK param -> JSON key -> server field). Helps infra folks.

samir (SDK): I'll also draft a codemod for JS that renames common params in example repos and put it in a Gist linked from the PR.

andrew (PM): Timeline: can we get this merged before next release (Tue)? If so, callers won't see diffs in behavior.

alyssa (Docs): Targeting EOD Monday. If anyone's blocked, ping me here.

jess (Writer): :thumbsup:

samir (SDK): noted :+1:

alyssa (Docs): small follow-up: can we add a test snippet that demonstrates function-calling with both key styles so SDK team can validate generator output?

sophia (DevEx): yep — I'll add a snippet and a tiny test harness that runs against staging.

alyssa (Docs): thanks all — will update PR and request reviews from @samir, @jess, @sophia.

(THREAD END)
